Be careful
Jul 2026 • Family
Dinner
We are visiting Đà Nẵng for a few days and chose this restaurant based on its strong reviews. Unfortunately, we were very disappointed with our dining experience.
The service was good — the servers were attentive and responsive to our needs.
Most of the seafood we ordered was fresh, except for the king crab. We personally selected a live king crab from the tank, which cost over $300 USD. As a family that frequently eats fresh seafood, we are quite familiar with its taste and quality.
However, even though the crab was alive when we picked it, the meat served at the table was clearly not fresh. The texture was soft, the meat fell apart easily, and it had no fresh flavor at all. It felt as though the crab may have been swapped in the kitchen. Our kids had already eaten most of it before we noticed the issue.
The manager came to our table, apologized, and took the remaining crab back to the kitchen. We don’t know whether he discussed the matter with the chef or the staff responsible. He later returned and offered us a 10% discount along with a complimentary plate of fruit.
While we appreciate the gesture and did not want to cause a big scene, we believe it is important to share this honest feedback. Experiences like this should not happen to other guests, and we hope the restaurant will improve its quality control to prevent similar issues in the future.

Quality seafood experience
Jul 2025 • Family
We had a lovely dinner at Muôì Biên — the food was genuinely excellent, the service friendly, and the location right on the beach made for a perfect setting. The papaya salad was fresh and flavourful, and the lobster (recommend grilled with garlic or baked with cheese) was a definite highlight — absolutely delicious.

That said, it was quite pricey, and we were disappointed that the staff didn’t guide us a little better when we ordered. We ended up with far too much food, which felt wasteful and unnecessary. At this price point, a bit of advice on portions would have been appreciated, as many other restaurants do make those helpful suggestions.

Still, if you’re after a quality seafood experience in Da Nang with beautiful beachfront views, this place is worth a visit — just be mindful of how much you order!

The best Tiger prawns cooked.
Dec 2024 • Family
I never really write reviews, but the seafood that I experienced here compelled me to feedback. I had Tiger prawns cooked in garlic oil. I’m sometimes apprehensive about ordering prawns as in a lot of places you have to shell them yourself and the taste of the garlic etc doesn’t really improve the taste of the flesh. These were totally different to my previous experiences. The main part of the prawn had been shelled already, the prawn butterflied and then coated in batter, and the cooked in garlic and oil and served with a chilli dip. Absolutely superb, and because of the way they had been cooked, remained hot throughout. For me, a 5 out of 5.
